electrical.howTo: This is the floor plan of your studio, seen from above. You place three things on it, one after another.

roof.alt: Presidio roof plan, door on the left, with three possible skylight openings. Dimensions above the back wall read 10 feet, 6 feet, and 2 feet.

preview.alt: Presidio studio with the picked stain on the facade and the picked decking on the deck.
preview.caption: Approx. colors
preview.empty: Pick a stain and decking to see them here.

prices.note: List prices of the extras you picked, installed. The price of the studio itself is in your quote. Your manager confirms the final total.

cover.alt: Presidio studio with the door on the left, wood front, and a corner deck.
cover.caption: Your studio: Presidio, door on the left.
cover.title: Welcome to the Wellmade Finish Selector
text: You received this form to choose the details of your future studio.
We order materials and build from your answers, so please make sure they are what you really want.

contact.text: Any question or doubt along the way? You are always welcome to contact your Wellmade manager.
contact.textNamed: Any question or doubt along the way? You are always welcome to contact your manager, {manager}.

cover.invite: Let's go through it together, one step at a time.

steps.title: Finishes
steps.intro: Let's start outside. Choose the stain for the walls and watch the picture change. Picture colors are approximate; the samples are the reference.

items.label: Decking
items.lead: Now the deck. First, the boards.
items.hint: For custom decking, describe it in Comments below.

groups.title: Trex Select series
groups.text: Durable composite decking with a subtle woodgrain texture. Included when a deck is selected.

groups.title: Trex Transcend series
groups.text: Enhanced woodgrain texture, richer colours and thicker deck boards. Additional cost.

groups.title: TimberTech decking
groups.text: Premium composite decking with distinctive woodgrain textures and rich colour variations. Additional cost.

items.label: Deck configuration
items.lead: Then the shape of the deck.

items.label: A dimension
items.hint: In feet. See A on the drawing of the custom corner deck.

items.label: B dimension
items.hint: In feet. See B on the drawing of the custom corner deck.

more.label: Laminate or engineered hardwood
text: Waterproof laminate: a wood-look image under a hard protective layer. Its maker rates it waterproof, and it can be wet-mopped.
Engineered hardwood: a top layer of real white oak over plywood. Every board has its own grain, and the floor can be refinished. It is not waterproof and is cleaned dry.

steps.title: Add-ons
steps.intro: Would you like any of these? Please answer for each one.

items.title: Skylight
items.text: 24" x 46". Opens by hand or with a remote.

items.label: Skylight location
items.hint: This is the roof of your studio, seen from above. Tap one of the three spots.

steps.title: Electrical
steps.intro: By default Wellmade installs a 125 amp, 2 circuit breaker box 5 ft above the ground, one exterior outlet right under it, and 3 interior outlets 18" above the floor. Below you choose the connection and where everything goes.

items.label: Connection
items.hint: Choose plug-in or hardline. Add Ethernet or third-party work if you need them. The Ethernet price applies together with a hardline connection.

options.label: Electrical work completed by a third-party contractor

items.label: Breaker box location
items.ask: Where should the breaker box go?
items.hint: Tap one of the four spots on the plan, B1 to B4.

items.label: Exterior outlet locations
items.ask: Do you want more exterior outlets?
items.hint: One exterior outlet right under the breaker box is included. Tap other spots to add more; each one has a price.

items.label: Interior outlet locations
items.ask: Where do you want the interior outlets?
items.hint: Three interior outlets are included and already marked. Tap other spots to add more; each one has a price. To move an included outlet, tap it off, tap the new spot, and tell us in Comments.

steps.title: Permits
steps.intro: Last question. You probably already know whether your studio needs a permit. Not sure? Leave this empty: your manager will contact you about it.

items.label: Permitting
items.emptyText: Left empty: your manager will contact you
items.hint: Building and Electrical can be combined.

more.label: About permits
text: Your local building code sets whether a studio of this size needs a permit. If you know, mark it. If not, leave it empty: we will help you find out.

steps.title: Review
steps.intro: Please check everything once more: we order materials and build from this. Then press Send.
steps.detailsHint: Please check that these are right.

rules.question: permits
rules.why: NO permit cannot be combined with Building or Electrical.

rules.question: connection
rules.why: Plug-in and hardline are two ways of the same connection; Ethernet and third-party stay independent.

rules.question: exterior
rules.why: PDF page 4: one exterior outlet right under the breaker box is included; more than one at extra charge.

rules.question: interior
rules.why: PDF page 4: the 3 outlets joined to the 'Interior Outlets' label come with the base model; more at additional charge.
The location is asked only after a skylight is chosen.

rules.note: A and B apply to a custom corner deck.
